derivation: from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G3563 (νοῦς);
def: to be well- minded, i.e. reconcile

occurrences.text: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
